s140.sec5.u7: All the Digimon worked as one

s140.sec5.u9: "This is a tale of long ago."
s140.sec5.u10: Wheee... I'm feeling all happy... Oops, no! That song was about this island's past, right? About how the Digimon beat a bad guy long ago... Hmm... A bad guy... Who could it have been?
s140.sec5.u11: Thanks for saving us. This is a little thank-you gift.
s140.sec5.u12: The stuffed Monzaemon joined the city!
s140.sec5.u14: Good luck! It's the house next door!
s140.sec5.u16: Want to hear our chorus again?
s140.sec5.u17: Oh, Monzaemon! You came back to life!
s140.sec5.u19: Hurry and beat WaruMonzaemon! Everyone has stopped moving! Hurry, hurry!
s140.sec5.u20: H-hold on a sec! This guy isn't the Monzaemon you know.
s140.sec5.u21: Huh? Oh dear. But he's still Monzaemon, right?
s140.sec5.u22: Well... he's a Monzaemon all right.
s140.sec5.u23: Then please! A baaaaaaaaaad guy called WaruMonzaemon kidnapped my friend.
s140.sec5.u24: Monzaemon is probably the only one who can beat him!
s140.sec5.u25: Mmm... I can't let that slide. All right, where is he?
s140.sec5.u26: He's in the house next door. I'll break the seal on the door, so go and see!
s140.sec5.u27: Got it, okay. We'll help you out!
